name: captia-os
description: CAPTIA OS: plataforma de dispositivos Android, telecomunicaciones, correo, identidades e IA

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" run build
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @captia/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @captia/web run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run test && scripts/test-db.sh pnpm run test:with-db
scripts.validate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:web
scripts.bootstrap-admin: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @captia/api run bootstrap-admin
